home.tagline: Play Splendor Marvel solo. Your table holds the game — this app runs Thanos: his deck, his tokens, his race to the Gauntlet.

setup.title: NEW GAME
table: Deal 4 cards per level, level 1 at the bottom
Keep 4 tokens of each colour, 2 green, all 5 grey
2 random Location tiles + Avengers & Gauntlet tiles
Leave space for Thanos’s colour piles

lengthTip.title: Game length
lengthTip.body: A community tweak from BGG: 10/9/8 (27 rounds) was “still too easy”, 8/8/8 (24) “pretty hard”.

capTip.title: Token cap
capTip.body: A community suggestion: cap his tokens at 12; the oldest beyond the cap go back to the supply.

logCardsTip.title: Your cards
logCardsTip.body: Logging your recruits lets the app track your points, colours and Time token, move the Avengers tile and run the tiebreakers. If you don’t log them, tick “I completed the Gauntlet” in the round you complete it, and move the Avengers tile yourself. The app asks for your points and card count only if a tiebreaker needs them.

setup.rulingsRow: Rulings for gaps in the automa

rulings.title: RULINGS
rulings.intro: The automa PDF leaves a few gaps. Defaults follow the BGG clarifications — change them if your table rules differ.

countedTip.title: Which cards count
countedTip.body: The PDF boxes his cards without points or Avengers tags, which breaks its own colour rule. Clarified on BGG (2021): keep any card with a colour he needs — so in effect every colour counts.

card12Tip.title: Card 12
card12Tip.body: Its phase-3 section (“C1”) prints no number. The original base-game card is the same, so it’s probably intentional.

emptySlotTip.title: Empty slot
emptySlotTip.body: Neither the PDF nor BGG covers this. “First in row” matches the left-to-right scan of the colour rule.

tiesTip.title: Ties
tiesTip.body: The PDF says to apply the normal winning conditions and that Thanos wins a draw: official tiebreakers first (points, Avengers tile, fewer cards), then Thanos.

rules.title: Thanos’s turn
rules.text: Thanos goes first every round: flip the next automa card and do the action in the section for the current phase (green rounds 1–10, yellow 11–20, red 21–30). The deck is reshuffled between phases.

rules.title: Taking tokens
rules.text: He takes the tokens shown, in printed order (1 Power, 2 Mind, 3 Space, 4 Reality, 5 Soul), onto his piles. Skip any colour whose pile is empty. He has no 10-token limit.

rules.title: Recruiting & colour substitution
rules.text: He takes the card in the named slot (row A = level 3 on top, C = level 1 at the bottom; columns from the left). If he already has that colour, he takes the first card in the row in a colour he lacks; none? then the original.

rules.title: Returning tokens (oldest first)
rules.text: When he recruits he returns the printed number of tokens, oldest first. He still takes the card if he can’t return them all, or any.

rules.title: Avengers tile & Locations
rules.text: The first side with 3+ Avengers tags takes the Avengers Assemble tile (+3); only more tags take it away. Thanos never takes Locations.

rules.title: Winning & tiebreakers
rules.text: At the end of a round, 16+ points, a bonus of every colour and the green Time token complete the Gauntlet. Ties: more points, then the Avengers tile, then fewer cards; then Thanos. After the last round without your Gauntlet, you lose.

logCard.title: LOG YOUR CARD
logCard.note: Level 3 cards also give you the green Time token.
